newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher, Nikkei pokes above 18,500.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher, Nikkei pokes above 18,500.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended sharply higher on Monday with the Nikkei benchmark average closing above 18,500 for the first time in a month, buoyed by buying of chemical and steel stocks, brokers said.
They said buy-backs of financial sector issues also lifted the market.
The 225-share Nikkei average finished 199.52 points or 1.09 percent higher at 18,551.66, after moving in positive territory throughout the session.
June Nikkei futures added 180 points to end at 18,580.

"Index-linked buying, possibly by public funds, appeared once again today to provide the Nikkei average with support," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said. "Market sentiment has improved considerably."
